import openpyxl

def get_bright_green_cells(file_path):
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
    ws = wb.active
    coords = []
    for row in ws.iter_rows():
        for cell in row:
            fill = cell.fill
            if fill and getattr(fill.fgColor, 'type', None) == 'rgb':
                if fill.fgColor.rgb == 'FF00FF00':  # strict bright green only
                    coords.append((cell.row, cell.column))
    return coords

cells = get_bright_green_cells('/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/5cfb274c-0207-4aa7-9575-6ac0bd95d9b2.xlsx')
print('Filtered green cells (bright only):', cells)
